prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a rear-end collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1045; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Rear bumper cover cracked and displaced, with the trunk lid edge and right quarter panel showing deformation consistent with a rear-end impact of the reported type. Tail lamp assembly and rear reinforcement bar require replacement, and the spare tire well shows minor crush that can be straightened in place. Labor hours requested align with the extent of the damage observed. The repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover and lamp assembly, straightening the quarter panel, refinishing the affected panels, and recalibrating the parking sensors. Nothing in the vehicle condition suggests earlier damage in these areas, and the invoices submitted show no duplicated line items.
